asr.full_text: Computers can be a problem, but here at HSN, we'll make it all easier. Meet the 15-inch, 4-Gigabyte desktop from HP. This computer has a stunning display. It brings you closer to photos and movies you've enjoyed watching. And you don't have to worry that the computer will hang up. You have time to surf the web or play the latest game of the year. It comes with a 4-core Intel Pentium processor ideal for launching all programs and games as well as any other app you use at the same time. Can you believe how much space you have in this £ 4.12 laptop? You get a whole 2TB hard drive to store all of the important documents, photos, home and music film and be in touch with your family, friends and loved ones regardless of where you are. Thanks to the pre-connected Truvision HD internet camera, you can always connect to the latest and best devices here at HSN.
